data.name: Kanwar
data.long_meaning: A name of God Krishna or Shiva, meaning 'Carrier of God's weapon'. The name Kanwar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kanaka' which means 'Golden', 'Rich' and 'Worthy'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that God Krishna or Shiva carries a 'Kanwar' or a 'Krishak', a wooden pole or a trident, respectively.
